no_adcom_quote.quote: This NDA was not presented at the Antimicrobial Drug Advisory Committee because GLE/PIB received breakthrough designation and the benefit/risk assessment did not appear controversial based on the review team's preliminary assessment of the top line trial results.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for MAVYRET (glecaprevir/pibrentasvir, NDA209394). The FDA Summary Review and Medical Review both state the NDA was not presented at the Antimicrobial Drug Advisory Committee because the product had breakthrough therapy designation and the benefit/risk assessment did not appear controversial based on the review team's preliminary assessment of top-line trial results. Because no AdComm was held, there were no committee concerns or resulting changes to the approval.
